# references

dth-hrh's bibliography: one folio-reference/v1 CSL-JSON node per entry of the document's [References](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#reference) chapter (`folio/dth-hrh/references/p-references.md`), `<key>.json`, in the KG at `references/<key>` (owner, 2026-11-02: "each document should have a bibliography pages which includes refrenced content in the document"). Committee content, wording kept: each node's fields are taken word for word from its entry, and `_comment` holds the entry as printed. The [References](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#reference) chapter's block names every node in `cites`, in chapter order, so the chapter and the KG Bibliography (`en/folio-assistant-core/bibliography/`) list the same works. A key shared with the who-iris catalogue, a library asset or another folio's bibliography names the same work there.
